system.description:
Once you have located a target using Gather Information, you can track its electronic presence. Once per day, you receive a catalog of the target's Electronic Trail, which includes the amount and location of credits spent, the routes of any public transportation taken, and the sites viewed on the HoloNet while the target was logged in using its primary identity.

To receive this information, you must have access to a computer or Datapad plus access to a network or The HoloNet. This Electronic Trail does not reveal bank balances or other secret information, which requires a separate Gather Information check.

prerequisite.text: Nowhere to Hide talent, and Trained in Use Computer
